[size=5]---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/size]



[font=Courier New][color=#f4cccc][size=5][center]﻿[b]˗ˏˋ ♡ introduction ♡ ˎˊ˗[/b][/center][/size]
[/color][/font]
[size=2][font=Arial][color=#f4f4f4]hello everyone! this is kate aka katestardew. i think it's only right i start this with a message. it has been more than a year since i've shared photos of this mod here and on my tumblr. i would like to sincerely apologize for the long delay as i know many have been waiting for the release of this. to be honest, it's still far from being complete or being considered as a huge furniture set like other mods created for stardew valley. yet, i tried my very best to input as many as i can during those times, but i admit that there were already a lot going on with my life as someone in college and many personal things happened; i also took decided to focus on other interests such as mainly playing video games or drawing, studying etc. overall, there were many times too that i've lost motivation to continue nor fix it.

yet, after such a long time, i have just decided to release what i currently have right now and if i ever feel like adding more stuff + maybe even making other mods too, i'll just update from time-to-time when i can. once again, i'm so sorry for the inactivity and constantly postponing this before. honestly, i'm just glad now that i finally picked myself up again to create the mod so it'll be usable to many players finally. thank you again for the support i have received here and on my stardew valley tumblr blog! ( ˊᵕˋ )[/color][/font]
[/size]

[font=Courier New][color=#f4cccc][size=5][b][center]˗ˏˋ ♡ about the mod ♡ ˎˊ˗[/center][/b][/size][/color][/font]
[font=Arial][size=3]as said in the brief overview, Casual Furniture Set is a furniture mod that is filled with cute and pastel pieces. currently, this pack [u][color=#ead1dc]only holds 30+ furniture[/color][/u][b] [/b][i]but as stated above,[/i] [u]i [/u][u]will just find time to add pieces when i can to update the set until i'm completely satisfied with the amount.[/u][/size][/font]

[list]
[*][font=Arial][color=#ffffff][size=3]this furniture set is available as an Alternative Texture and Custom Furniture mod. [/size][/color][/font]
[*][font=Arial][color=#ffffff][size=3]i could not make it into a Content Patcher one because i made multiple versions of one furniture in the set.[/size][/color][/font]
[*][font=Arial][color=#ffffff][size=3]but if you would like to learn how to merge the furniture.png i've included in the folders with the current CP furniture set you are using, you may refer to [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/SMAPI/comments/kmsu16/comment/ghjqytz/]this link[/url]. . . please make sure they're aligned well ! and for [b]personal use only[/b]. [/size][/color][/font]
[/list]
[color=#f4cccc][size=5][b][font=Courier New][center]﻿[/center][center]˗ˏˋ ♡ instructions ♡ ˎˊ˗[/center][/font][/b][/size][/color]
[list=1]
[font=Arial][*][size=3]make sure you have SMAPI installed to use mods.[/size]
[*][size=3]if you would like to use the Custom Furniture (CF) version of this set, download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1254]Custom Furniture[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK[/url]﻿. [/size]
[*][size=3]if you would like to use the Alternative Textures (AT) version of this set, download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url][/size]
[*][size=3]﻿put all the downloaded mods (based on your choice) in your Mods folder. by the way, you can use both versions of the furniture mod if you want![/size]
[*][size=3]turn on your game and have fun! [/size]
[/font][/list]
[font=Courier New][color=#f4cccc][size=5][b][center]˗ˏˋ ♡ closing ♡ ˎˊ˗[/center][/b][/size][/color][/font]
[list]
[*][color=#ffffff]﻿[font=Arial][size=3]if you have any questions, pls kindly ask me in the comment section. i'll try my best to answer them ![/size][/font][/color]
[*][font=Arial][color=#ffffff][size=3]if there are any errors or bugs, pls kindly tell me in the comment section as well so i can fix it as soon as possible.[/size][/color][/font]
[/list][font=Arial][size=3]
